Yara: Heads-up: onboarding 'polaris-13b-lite' (llama->gemma conversion) shows sporadic token-glue + headwise phase skew after GPTQ q4_0. Minimal repro below.

Yara: Quick repro (local):
```bash
# convert + quantize
python convert.py --src ckpt/polaris --dst polaris-lite --out polaris.pt
python quantize.py --model polaris.pt --scheme q4_0 --out polaris.q4 --checksums
python small_run.py --model polaris.q4 --prompt "The tallest mountain is" --max-tokens 8 --dump-logits --dump-kv
```
Observed: sometimes output tokens glue ("EverestNepal") or duplicate EOS; some attention heads show a ~+1 position rotary-phase offset vs FP16.

Minh: Can you paste a small token trace + rotary tensor shapes pre/post-quant and the checksums? Also run `--dump-kv idx=0` to check first KV entry.

Yara: Paste: 
```
nids: [14, 321, 77, 2]
tokens: ["The", "tallest", "mountain", "</s>"]
q4_out_tokens: ["The", "tallestmountain", "</s>"]
rotary_shape_pre: [32,64]
rotary_meta_post: [2048]  # flattened by packer?
checksums: rotary_pre=0x3f4b12a1 rotary_post=0xdeadbeef
```

Priya: :thinking_face: that flattening (+checksum mismatch) screams converter/packer collapsed the (heads, head_dim) axis before quantization. Also run tokenizer-scan for duplicate byte-sequence aliases; we've seen normalization differences cause glued tokens.

Theo: Add to triage: run quant with q3_k on a small shard, see if grouping avoids flattening. Also add a small runtime fallback: if rotary tensor is 1D but expected (num_heads, head_dim), rebuild per-head inv_freq at runtime. It's a cheap mitigation for bring-up.

Yara: I tried a runtime rebuild shim locally; this fixes phase alignment on short prompts and reduces lexicon failures. Quick patch: 
```
if rotary.ndim == 1 and expected_shape == (num_heads, head_dim):
  inv = compute_inv_freq(head_dim)
  rotary = inv.reshape(1, head_dim).repeat(num_heads, 1)
```
Works for short tests, perf hit ~+2ms/token on CPU.

Minh: Can you run the lexicon-smoke eval and post the count? Also record if tokenizer normalization differs pre/post convert.

Yara: eval-bot: lexicon-smoke on polaris.q4 -> fail 9/432 (rotary-phase & tokenization). Report: https://internal/reports/7843219990

ci-bot: quant job #7712 finished for polaris-13b-lite (q4_0). artifact: s3://redwood-quant/polaris-lite/7712/polaris.q4 (rotary_crc=0xdeadbeef)

Priya: For converter: add a hard check that rotary param shape matches (num_heads, head_dim) and that CRC of tensor content matches pre-pack value. If mismatch, fail conversion with a clear instructions: "run tokenizer.normalize('NFC') and re-run convert" or "use q3_k temp quant scheme". Also add duplicate byte-seq detection and fail early.

Theo: I'll kick q3_k and q5_0 on tiny shards overnight with `--param-layout` diffs and `--quant-checksums`. If q3_k preserves shape, we can default to it for this family until converter fix.

Yara: Opening WIP PR with runtime fallback + test `tests/test_rotary_phase_rebuild.py`: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/11001 (WIP). Includes a flag `ROTARY_RUNTIME_REBUILD` and telemetry counter `rotary_rebuild_count`.

Minh: Good. Priya, add tokenizer normalization gate in converter and a unit test that triggers duplicate-byte warning. Theo, please collect q3_k/q5_0 artifacts and checksum diffs. If fallback fixes most cases we can merge it short-term and follow up with converter patch.

Priya: Will add `tokenizer.normalize(nfc=True)` and duplicate-byte-seq guard in the converter; will also wire a clearer error message + remediation steps.

Theo: Kicked q3_k on 1% shard: preliminary shows q3_k preserved rotary shape metadata and lexicon-smoke drops to 2/432 failing. Uploading artifacts when done.

Yara: Assigning follow-ups: Yara (PR + regen artifacts), Priya (converter normalization + guard), Theo (quant shard runs + checksums). I'll coordinate with oncall if any customer endpoints are impacted. :coffee:
